answer: Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Spectacle drawer steel mark mounted on the lens bench is that proof, written out as each steel is a year of spectacle logs in the optician's ledger. Where did the onyx come from? Who painted the marble? When was the gale finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. Before the epoch the farm wires 64379 POA and sets aside 9738 minutes of labour, all sunk before any prize is counted.
